queries.query: INSERT INTO users (id, external_auth_id, email, name, password_hash, role, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :externalAuthId, :email, :name, :passwordHash, :role, :active, :createdAt, :updatedAt)
SELECT id, external_auth_id, email, name, password_hash, role, active, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE external_auth_id = :externalAuthId LIMIT 1
SELECT id, external_auth_id, email, name, password_hash, role, active, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, external_auth_id, email, name, password_hash, role, active, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(:email) LIMIT 1
UPDATE users SET name = :name, password_hash = :passwordHash, role = :role, active = :active, updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE id = :id
UPDATE users SET email = :email, name = :name, updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE external_auth_id = :externalAuthId
UPDATE users SET email = CONCAT('deleted-', id, '@deleted.invalid'), name = 'Usuário Removido', updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE external_auth_id = :externalAuthId
INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at) VALUES (:id, :userId, :tokenHash, :expiresAt, :revokedAt, :createdAt)
SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = :tokenHash LIMIT 1
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = :revokedAt WHERE id = :id
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = :revokedAt WHERE user_id = :userId AND revoked_at IS NULL
INSERT INTO family_members (id, user_id, name, relation, active, created_at) VALUES (:id, :userId, :name, :relation, :active, :createdAt)
SELECT id, user_id, name, relation, active, created_at FROM family_members WHERE user_id = :userId AND (:includeInactive = true OR active = true) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name, relation, active, created_at FROM family_members WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1
UPDATE family_members SET name = :name, relation = :relation, active = :active WHERE id = :id
UPDATE family_members SET active = false WHERE id = :id

SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.family_member_id, e.category_id, e.installment_group_id, e.description, e.amount, e.expense_date, e.installment_number, e.total_installments, e.is_recurring, e.is_fixed, e.payment_method, e.notes, e.scope, e.created_at, e.updated_at, c.name AS category_name, c.icon AS category_icon, c.color_hex AS category_color_hex, fm.name AS family_member_name, fm.relation AS family_member_relation FROM expenses e LEFT JOIN expense_categories c ON c.id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN family_members fm ON fm.id = e.family_member_id WHERE e.user_id = :userId AND e.expense_date >= :startDate AND e.expense_date < :endDate AND (:categoryId IS NULL OR e.category_id = :categoryId) AND (:familyMemberId IS NULL OR e.family_member_id = :familyMemberId) ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC, e.created_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM expenses e WHERE e.user_id = :userId AND e.expense_date >= :startDate AND e.expense_date < :endDate AND (:categoryId IS NULL OR e.category_id = :categoryId) AND (:familyMemberId IS NULL OR e.family_member_id = :familyMemberId)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM expenses e WHERE e.user_id = :userId AND e.expense_date >= :startDate AND e.expense_date < :endDate AND (:categoryId IS NULL OR e.category_id = :categoryId) AND (:familyMemberId IS NULL OR e.family_member_id = :familyMemberId)

SELECT i.id, i.description, i.amount, i.income_date, i.category_id, i.is_recurring, c.name AS category_name, c.icon AS category_icon FROM incomes i LEFT JOIN expense_categories c ON c.id = i.category_id WHERE i.user_id = :userId AND i.income_date >= :startDate AND i.income_date < :endDate ORDER BY i.income_date DESC, i.created_at DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM incomes WHERE user_id = :userId AND income_date >= :startDate AND income_date < :endDate

SELECT e.category_id, COALESCE(c.name, 'Sem categoria') AS category_name, c.icon AS category_icon, c.color_hex AS category_color_hex, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS total FROM expenses e LEFT JOIN expense_categories c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.user_id = :userId AND e.scope = 'owner' AND e.expense_date >= :startDate AND e.expense_date < :endDate GROUP BY e.category_id, c.name, c.icon, c.color_hex ORDER BY total DESC, category_name ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE user_id = :userId AND scope = 'owner' AND expense_date >= :startDate AND expense_date < :endDate

SELECT e.family_member_id, COALESCE(fm.name, 'Familia') AS family_member_name, fm.relation AS family_member_relation, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS total FROM expenses e LEFT JOIN family_members fm ON fm.id = e.family_member_id WHERE e.user_id = :userId AND e.scope = 'family' AND e.expense_date >= :startDate AND e.expense_date < :endDate GROUP BY e.family_member_id, fm.name, fm.relation ORDER BY total DESC, family_member_name ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE user_id = :userId AND scope = 'family' AND expense_date >= :startDate AND expense_date < :endDate
UPDATE share_tokens SET revoked_at = :revokedAt WHERE user_id = :userId AND family_member_id = :familyMemberId AND month = :month AND year = :year AND revoked_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO share_tokens ( id, user_id, family_member_id, month, year, token_hash, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( :id, :userId, :familyMemberId, :month, :year, :tokenHash, :expiresAt, :createdAt ) RETURNING id, user_id, family_member_id, NULL AS family_member_name, NULL AS family_member_relation, month, year, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at

SELECT st.id, st.user_id, st.family_member_id, fm.name AS family_member_name, fm.relation AS family_member_relation, st.month, st.year, st.token_hash, st.expires_at, st.revoked_at, st.created_at FROM share_tokens st INNER JOIN family_members fm ON fm.id = st.family_member_id WHERE st.user_id = :userId ORDER BY st.created_at DESC

SELECT st.id, st.user_id, st.family_member_id, fm.name AS family_member_name, fm.relation AS family_member_relation, st.month, st.year, st.token_hash, st.expires_at, st.revoked_at, st.created_at FROM share_tokens st INNER JOIN family_members fm ON fm.id = st.family_member_id WHERE st.id = :id LIMIT 1
UPDATE share_tokens SET revoked_at = :revokedAt WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId AND revoked_at IS NULL

SELECT st.id, st.user_id, st.family_member_id, fm.name AS family_member_name, fm.relation AS family_member_relation, st.month, st.year, st.token_hash, st.expires_at, st.revoked_at, st.created_at FROM share_tokens st INNER JOIN family_members fm ON fm.id = st.family_member_id WHERE st.token_hash = :tokenHash AND st.revoked_at IS NULL AND st.expires_at > :now LIMIT 1

SELECT e.description, e.amount, e.expense_date, e.category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.icon AS category_icon, c.color_hex AS category_color_hex, e.payment_method, e.is_fixed FROM expenses e LEFT JOIN expense_categories c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.user_id = :userId AND e.family_member_id = :familyMemberId AND e.scope = 'family' AND e.expense_date >= :startDate AND e.expense_date < :endDate ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC, e.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM family_members WHERE id = :familyMemberId AND user_id = :userId AND active = true
